title: 2020-21 Panini Prizm Pink Ice Prizm #153 Dejounte Murray San Antonio Spurs Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
Up for sale is a 2020-21 Panini Prizm sports trading card featuring Dejounte Murray of the San Antonio Spurs. This card is part of the Pink Ice Prizm parallel/variety and is card number 153 in the set. It is a great addition to any basketball fan's collection, especially those who collect cards from the National Basketball Association (NBA).

This card features Dejounte Murray in action and is a base set card with a Pink Ice Prizm variety. It does not come autographed, but it is in excellent condition. Don't miss out on the chance to add this card to your collection!
